requirements.title: NINT argument restrictions
requirements.definition: A shall be real; optional KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.NINT-A-real: Positive source control calls NINT with real A values 2.25 and -2.5; source-control mutation changes A to an integer actual and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.NINT-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-expres: Positive source control calls NINT with KIND=KIND(0); source-control mutations use a noninteger or nonconstant KIND expression and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: NINT result is integer with KIND selection
requirements.definition: The NINT result is integer; with KIND present its kind type parameter is the value of KIND, and with KIND absent it is default integer.

pending.NINT-result-integer: Assign NINT(2.25) to an integer sentinel variable initialized to -77 and assert the assignment changes it to 2; source mutation replaces NINT by AINT so the integer assignment or kind check fails.
pending.NINT-result-kind-from-KIND: Guarded plan probes a nondefault integer kind through SELECTED_INT_KIND; after availability is established, assert KIND(NINT(2.25,KIND=that_kind)) equals that kind and mutate KIND to KIND(0).
pending.NINT-result-default-kind-absent: Assert KIND(NINT(2.25)) equals KIND(0), paired with an explicit KIND=KIND(0) companion to avoid an absent-argument parser special case.

requirements.title: NINT result selects nearest integer with greater-magnitude tie break
requirements.definition: The NINT result is the integer nearest A, with ties resolved to the integer of greater magnitude.

pending.NINT-nearest-integer: Use exactly representable real inputs 2.25, 2.75, -2.25, and -2.75; assert exact integer results 2, 3, -2, and -3 after nonmatching sentinels, and mutate the intrinsic to INT so fractional nearest cases fail.
pending.NINT-halfway-greater-magnitude: Use exactly representable halfway inputs 2.5 and -2.5; assert exact integer results 3 and -3, and mutate the tie rule to truncation or smaller magnitude so both signs discriminate.
